title: Chapter 1435
text:
Han Xiao did not even turn around as he casually replied, "As you can see, these are the reinforcements I pulled in to fill the gap in our two-front battle."

The Ethereal Pope knocked on the table with his knuckles and said with a deep voice, "Don't play dumb. I'm asking how they came. When did you revive these people?"

Hearing this, Han Xiao turned his head and glanced at the three of them, his tone faint.

"Do you think all the revivors are willing to appear in public? I never said that the ones in the association are all the revivors. As for who exactly I revived, I have no obligation to tell others. Don't ask what you shouldn't ask."

The three of them choked and looked at him deeply.

They did not need to think too much to guess that this was Black Star's backup plan. He had secretly hidden a group of revivors. It was most likely arranged during the confrontation back then as a trump card against the three Universal Civilizations.

If he had stubbornly launched the purge back then, the outcome would have been hard to say. Now that Han Xiao had revealed this trump card, the three of them were almost shocked and felt a little afraid.

However, after knowing each other for so many years, the three of them were already quite familiar with Black Star's unfathomable habits. They were already used to Black Star placing spies everywhere. Perhaps this group of revivors that suddenly appeared was only the tip of the iceberg …

The three of them retracted their gazes with heavy hearts.

Now was not the time to care about such things, but the three of them still respected Han Xiao even more.

Now that Black Star was on the same level as them, the three of them did not ask further when they saw that he did not want to explain.

Furthermore, compared to the importance of Black Star himself, a group of revivors did not seem to be a big deal. With a Transcendent like Han Xiao in front of them, the impact of this group of hidden revivors on the three of them was limited.

Han Xiao naturally would not take the initiative to explain the origin of the Holy Covenant. Looking at the three of them with stern expressions, he could not help but smirk.

Back then, hiding the strength of the Holy Covenant organization was to leave a way out for the association, so that the Beyond Grade As would be divided into two sides, one in the light and the other in the dark, guarding each other.

He had originally planned to reveal the tip of the iceberg of the Holy Covenant at the right time to make the three Universal Civilizations hesitate, but his plan could not keep up with the changes. Now that he had stepped into the Transcendent Grade, his deterrence was comparable to the entire Beyond Grade A group. The trump card of the Holy Covenant Revivors was not as important as before … However, it was still useful. It was not a bad thing to make the three Universal Civilizations fear him a little more.

Han Xiao paid attention to the battle again. After watching for a while, he suddenly locked onto the Secret Tree King and Clottey, who were fighting on the surveillance screen. His eyes flashed.

"My prey has appeared. Excuse me, the three of you."

As soon as he finished speaking, the remote projection disappeared.

Only then did the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations relax. They looked at each other and saw the fear in each other's eyes.

…

Shallow layer Dimensional Battlefield, a certain battle zone.

Bang!

A rainbow-like magic flash pierced through the surging dark energy and landed on Clottey's body, leaving behind new wounds. The powerful annihilation power sent him flying all the way to the dark brown ground, smashing through hundreds of layers.

"Cough cough …"

The cells in his body withered under the influence of the annihilation magic. Clottey quickly used his energy to stabilize his injuries. He then looked up at the enemy in the sky with a solemn expression.

The Secret Tree King was floating in the air, looking down at him from above. Forbidden spells were brewing around him, quickly taking shape and falling like a storm.

Clottey gritted his teeth and suppressed his injuries. He controlled the dark energy to meet the attack, but after a moment of stalemate, he was sent flying again, and many new wounds appeared on his body.

"This Tree King … is a little too strong …"

Clottey covered his wounds, his eyes flashing with shock.

His judgment of the Tree King's strength came from the Lord's Avatar of the Subduing Tree King, the Heart Tree King, and the Fortitude Tree King. He had thought that even if he could not defeat this new Tree King, he would at least be able to hold on for a long time. However, Clottey did not expect this guy who called himself the Secret Tree King to be clearly stronger than the other three. He was a National Pillar after all, but the other party beat him up like he was his younger brother. It was very easy for him.

Of all the people he had fought before, only Black Star and Wuornos could crush him so easily.

If the other Beyond Grade A Mages were ordinary magic cannons, then this Secret Tree King was a magic nuclear bomb. The strength, frequency, and speed of his casting far surpassed all the Mages Clottey had ever seen!

In the sky, the Secret Tree King stopped attacking and moved his fingers. He casually played with a magic ribbon and said casually, "You actually dared to challenge me to a duel.

Should I say that your courage is commendable, or that you overestimate yourself? Unfortunately, only that Mechanic or that Esper has the qualifications to fight me. Your strength is a little weak. If this continues, you won't be able to arouse my interest in killing you … "

The only opponents that the Secret Tree King placed in his eyes were Han Xiao and EsGod. Although Clottey's combat strength was not low, and his Esper Ability to control dark energy was quite sharp, it was not much of a threat to a supreme Mage like him who controlled multi-dimensional energy.

Feeling the other party's contempt, Clottey's face darkened. He silently gathered his energy and prepared to fight with all his might.

However, at this moment, a spatial fluctuation appeared in their senses. The spatial wall in the distance opened up, and a figure hidden under a hooded black robe shuttled over. His robe fluttered in the wind, and the edges were like black flames. His entire body was brimming with the aura of a peak Beyond Grade A, attracting their attention.

"Who are you?" Clottey turned around. He did not know if he was an enemy or a friend, so he immediately raised his guard.

"One of us."

Oathkeeper glanced at him and then stared at the Secret Tree King, locking onto him with his aura.

"Another one?" The Secret Tree King narrowed his eyes. "You're in cahoots with that group of unfamiliar reinforcements, right? You should be their leader. Interesting, you guys actually have a group of high-level combatants hidden … Heh, so what? The situation can't be salvaged. Sooner or later, we will destroy all your forces in the secondary dimensions!"

Through the mental network, he had already learned about the situation of the Holy Covenant Revivors supporting the Beyond Grade As of the three Universal Civilizations.

In the Secret Tree King's opinion, facing an opponent like the World Tree, the three Universal Civilizations would feel immense pressure and should have gone all out long ago. However, even now, the other party was still holding back. It was truly unfathomable.

Furthermore, with the Secret Tree King's personality, he was still a little unhappy about this … What, is our World Tree not worthy of your full strength?

Ignoring the Secret Tree King, Oathkeeper communicated with Clottey's mind and sent a telepathic message.

"Leave this to me. Go and help the others."

"Can you do it? This Tree King is very strong. It's best if we work together to deal with him. "Clottey expressed his doubts.

"This Tree King is a Mage. I can tell that his spells are enhanced in the secondary dimension world. I shouldn't be his match, but I only need to stall him. In this aspect, I'm more suitable than you. There's no need to waste your strength on him."

Oathkeeper replied.

Not long ago, the expeditionary army outpost was attacked, and Han Xiao finally informed the Holy Covenant organization to participate in the battle. Many Holy Covenant Revivors had long been mentally prepared. They did not need to be mobilized and set off on their own. On one hand, it was for the sake of the Sanctum Revival qualifications, and on the other hand, it was because they were interdependent.

Other than that, Han Xiao also asked the Holy Covenant to bring Dimensional Exile Bullets, Advanced Life Form Energy Chaos Wave, Interdimensional Detection Radar, and other special technologies to provide support. Oathkeeper had no choice but to do as he was told. As the Holy Covenant's troops had always been on standby, reinforcements arrived very quickly.

Before Clottey could reply, the Secret Tree King suddenly attacked. All sorts of powerful forbidden spells were cast one after another, firing at the two of them indiscriminately.

Bang! Bang!

Bang! Magic light flashed in the sky, beautiful and fatal. Oathkeeper and Clottey immediately reacted and moved around in the light curtain, dodging non-stop.

On the other side, the Secret Tree King was multitasking. He quickly constructed spell models one after another and threw out forbidden spells while communicating with the Ancestral Tree King through the mental network.

"There's no sign of that Mechanic in the frontline battlefield or the secondary dimension battlefield. He has that kind of sealing ability, so there's a high chance that he's targeting a tree king. Therefore, his target should be me. Maybe he's secretly observing. After I fight with these two opponents for a while, he should jump out and attack me."

Hearing this, the Ancestral Tree King agreed in the mental network and said with a deep voice, "Your judgment is very reasonable. Continue to fight. As long as that Mechanic is lured out, I will immediately descend and catch him off guard."

"Okay."

The two of them quickly came up with a plan and prepared to use the Secret Tree King as bait to lure the snake out of its hole.

The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind. Since Black Star was very likely targeting the Secret Tree King, the Ancestral Tree King also chose to launch an ambush. He had two main goals. The first was to find an opportunity to kill Black Star, and the second was to find a way to save the Heart Tree King … If he did not deal with Black Star, how could he unseal him? At the very least, he had to snatch the Universal Treasure of the person who sealed him.

It was not that they valued the Heart Tree King that much. Even the Subduing Tree King had used 'decisively' to self-destruct twice to escape the fate of being sealed. Only the Heart Tree King had been hit. The Ancestral Tree King only wanted to take back the sealed Tree King Crown. Otherwise, there would always be a vacancy among the five Tree Kings, and they would not even be able to change people.

With the addition of Oathkeeper, the two of them were finally in a stalemate with the Secret Tree King. The three of them fought fiercely, chasing each other non-stop. The battlefield changed again and again. One moment, it was the abyss-like black-purple space, the next moment, it was the holy-like Silver Kingdom, the next moment, it was the prototype of a new dimension, and the next moment, it was the unstable secondary dimension. Without exception, it was shattered by the shockwaves of the battle between the three of them, and batches of fleets were swallowed by the space storm.

The three of them arrived at a dark dimension. Suddenly, the space wall in the distance opened, and a new figure entered the battlefield. It was Han Xiao.

The Secret Tree King noticed Han Xiao immediately and immediately forgot about the other two opponents. He stared at Han Xiao, his eyes filled with strong fighting spirit and killing intent.

"You're finally willing to come out?"

Han Xiao glanced at him and waved his hand to get Oathkeeper and Clottey to stop and retreat to the side. Only then did he speak to the Secret Tree King in the public channel.

"We have three people here. Aren't you going to run?"

"Run? Who do you think I am? "

The Secret Tree King suddenly waved his hand, and an invisible spatial fluctuation swept across this space. The entire secondary dimension immediately turned into a mirror space, as if it was trapped in a crystal. The silhouettes of the battlefield flowed on the spatial facets, overlapping each other, dazzling one's eyes.

A spatial barrier suddenly formed, isolating Clottey and Oathkeeper. They could only see what was happening inside the barrier, but they could not participate in it. It was as if the two of them were in parallel spaces with no intersection.

Only the Secret Tree King and Han Xiao were in the barrier, looking at each other from afar.

"You want to fight me one-on-one?" Han Xiao glanced at the barrier and laughed strangely.

"I've always wanted to fight you. Why should I run? I thought you would launch a sneak attack, but I didn't expect you to appear so openly … However, it doesn't matter. This barrier is our duel. If you have the ability, don't use that teleportation technique to escape. I'll definitely kill you today!"

The Secret Tree King's eyes flickered. He knew that Black Star had teleportation techniques that could ignore control, so this barrier was only to prevent other enemies from disrupting the situation and creating the illusion of a one-on-one battle. As long as Black Star did not teleport away and stayed behind to fight him one-on-one, the plan would be half successful.

He did not hesitate and immediately cast all kinds of spells. All kinds of spells with strange effects focused on Han Xiao. On the surface, it seemed like a one-on-one battle, but he had already secretly used spells to guide the Ancestral Tree King into the barrier, preparing to launch a pincer attack.

However, before the spell could hit the target, a strong high-level pressure swept out like a storm with Han Xiao as the center, causing the Secret Tree King's mind to instinctively tremble!

Boom!

Countless machines surged out of the Divine Fortress and instantly condensed on Han Xiao's body, turning into a huge Mechanical Deity. It was the Supreme Heavenly Venerate, and the energy fluctuations of a Transcendent erupted without reservation!

The Secret Tree King's expression changed instantly, and the ferocity on his face turned into fear and disbelief.

"This is the level of a Tree God?"

He was not mentally prepared at all. He was scared out of his wits.

At this moment, all tactics and plans were thrown to the back of his mind.

The Secret Tree King constructed a teleportation gate without hesitation and was about to escape. He no longer had any arrogance, only panic.

However, Han Xiao was even faster than him. The huge mechanical body flashed and teleported behind the Secret Tree King. He reached out and tore apart the World Tree Roots around him. Then, the Emperor Skysplitter Blade slashed down, and an invisible psionic wave burst out like a blade wave.

Crack! Crack!

The sound of a mirror shattering could be heard. Within the range of the psionic wave, the spatial barrier, all kinds of forbidden spells, teleportation gates, and everything else constructed by magic power collapsed like a collapsing sandcastle!

There was no resistance at all!

"What?!"

The Ancestral Tree King, who had just teleported behind Han Xiao and was about to launch a sneak attack, froze on the spot, and his expression changed drastically!
